eventScripts.script:
if currentValue.value:
		
		log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_tag')
		import java.lang
		
		try:		
			chkEventFilterInfo = {}	
			chkEventFilterInfo['auto'] = False
			chkEventFilterInfo['chkShtStateNames'] = ['Due', 'Overdue', 'Coming Due']
			data = system.kanoa.quality.event.getChkShtEvents(chkEventFilterInfo)
			if data != 'Kanoa QDS License Expired':
				chkEventFilterInfo = {}	
				chkEventFilterInfo['startDate'] = system.date.addDays(system.date.now(), -1)
				chkEventFilterInfo['endDate'] = system.date.now()
				chkEventFilterInfo['chkShtStateNames'] = ['Approved', 'Submitted', 'Rejected', 'Missed', 'Canceled']
				chkEventFilterInfo['auto'] = False
			
				chkEvents = system.dataset.appendDataset(data, system.kanoa.quality.event.getChkShtEvents(chkEventFilterInfo))		
			
				system.tag.write("[.]chkEventData", chkEvents)
				
			system.tag.write("[.]lastUpdated", system.date.now())

		except java.lang.Exception, e:
			log.warn("%s timer script failed with %s"%(tagPath, e.cause))
		except:
			log.warn("%s timer script failed"%tagPath)	
			
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)			

		system.tag.writeBlocking(['[.]updateChkEventData'], [0], 5000)	#Need token passing here as the updateScheduleChecksTag() also writes to it 		
		
	return

tagPaths = ["[.]enabled", "[.]trigger", "[.]lastUpdated", "[.]intervalSecs"]
	tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagPaths)

	enabled = tagValues[0].value
	updating = tagValues[1].value
	lastUpdated = tagValues[2].value
	intervalSecs = tagValues[3].value or 60
 
	if enabled and not updating:
		if lastUpdated is None or system.date.secondsBetween(lastUpdated, system.date.now()) >= intervalSecs: 
			system.tag.writeBlocking(["[.]trigger"], [True])
		
	return
